name: Password
effect: A wall. Blocks descent until de-rezzed or bypassed with stealth.
flavor: A shimmering lattice of permission you do not have.

name: Hound
effect: Raises the alarm if not destroyed before it acts; accelerates the security clock.
flavor: It smells you the moment you jack in.

name: Rust
effect: Damage-over-time to the netrunner's deck HP each round it survives.
flavor: Your icebreakers come back slick and corroded.

name: Hellbolt
effect: Heavy single-target burst against the netrunner.
flavor: A column of white fire down the data spine.

name: Killer
effect: Lethal. If the netrunner flatlines to Killer, the meatspace body dies.
flavor: It does not want your data. It wants your brain.

name: Warden
effect: Persistent, high-durability; hard to remove, raises alarm while alive.
